ui:pending: The row waiting to be indexed.
area:Tags, links and saved searches: Tags and topics, the links between any two things, and saved searches.
table:sync_ranges: The stretches of each chat's history held completely, so a fetch knows what is missing.
table:persons: One human. Each person has identities in the sources; one person is the store's owner.
table:identities: How one source knows a person: a messenger user, an email address, a meeting participant.
table:identity_links: Which person an identity belongs to, how that was decided and how sure it is.
table:identity_link_events: Every move of an identity from one person to another, so a wrong link can be undone.
table:account_identities: Which identities each account sees, and when it last talked to each of them one to one.
table:chats: A place to talk in one account: a dialog, group, channel or saved messages. Chats can nest.
table:messages: One message in a chat, with its text, sender, reply and thread.
table:message_revisions: Earlier texts of a message, one row per edit.
table:message_counter_observations: The latest value of a message's views, reactions or comments counter.
table:reminders: When to remind someone about a task, and whether the reminder was delivered.
table:auto_tag_claims: Tags that rules put on a chat by matching its title, username and description.
table:conversations: A group of one chat's messages that belong to the same discussion, from one build.
table:search_terms: Every word in the message search index, for typo correction.
table:search_term_trigrams: Three-letter pieces of each search word, to find words that look like a mistyped one.
table:schema_migrations: Which migrations this file has applied.
col:identity_links.identity_id: the identity being linked; one link per identity
col:organizations.name: the organization's name
col:member_observations.observed_at: when the member list was read
col:proposed_actions.decided_at: when it was approved or rejected
col:proposed_actions.error: why it failed, when it did
col:agent_actions.error: why the call failed or was refused
col:agent_actions.finished_at: when it ended; null while it runs
col:conversation_state.chat_id: the chat; one row per chat with grouping turned on
col:search_index_state.name: which index the row describes, e.g. `message_words`
col:involvements.scope: `personal` or `work`, from the subject's account, chat or project
